about: F129 (#1239): what SocialUs can and can't do, one line per thing, in words a member would use. Hand-kept. Each line names the feature and the criteria in build-log/reports/rollup.json that must all be shipped, checked and not unsmoked for it to read as 'can'; who it is for (visitor: no account; member: signed in; runner: runs a Page or an event); and the routes in evals/screens/routes.ts whose live smoke proves it. 'notPlanned' marks a line nobody intends to build. Words are the PM's to change.

lines.words: See which Pages near you have something on, and sign in to read it
Type a zip to find out whether SocialUs is open where you live
Leave an email to be told when your area opens, without an account
Sign up with your name, email and zip; the zip sets your area
Help open your town by saying whether you make things or come to find them
Browse the Pages and posts near you, newest and closest first
See the list and the map side by side on a wide screen
See what's happening today and this week
Narrow what you see in plain words, and type the same words again later
Shelves of things to buy and do, including what's on in the next 7 days
Get a shelf for each interest you pick, up to three
Look around from a town you type, not only from home
Ask a question in plain words and be taken to the page that answers it
Follow a person, a Page or a venue, and see them in one list
Say you're coming to something, and take it back with one tap
Say you're in on a Proposal, or offer to help make it happen
Report anything you see, with a reason you choose
If your post is hidden, be told why and answer once, or fix it and post again
Show a display name to others while your legal name stays private
Change your zip and your area and home town follow
Host a gathering without opening a shop
Start a Page by answering one question, what kind it is
Agree to the house rules once, then publish your Page
Edit your Page's picture, name and description from one page
Put your Page on the map by address or by neighbourhood
Tag your Page in your own words
Give your Page a picture and add one photo to each post
Post an event or news from your Page, with a time and place
Make an event repeat every week
Post a Proposal, see who's in and by size, and accept helpers
Run more than one Page, and pick up any draft where you left it
Say which town your Page gives back to, and show the local badge
